result.summary: Found 2 issues: overlapping/garbled text on a restaurant card and a likely typo in a restaurant name.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the delivery time text is overlapping and unreadable ('25-3Ddelivery'), with the time range colliding with the word 'delivery'.
issues.suggestion: Give the delivery-time and metadata labels enough horizontal space or wrap them so they never overlap (e.g. '25–35 min · delivery · Ramen').

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Smash Bros Burgers' looks like a misspelling of 'Smash Bros. Burgers' / 'Smash Burger'.
issues.suggestion: Confirm the official restaurant name and correct the spelling if needed.
